phase3_findings.description: The load-bearing argparse-collision invariant (operand errors exit 1 from cmd_body so argparse usage-error exit 2 never collides with the absent-workpad exit 2) is never exercised end-to-end: every test builds argparse.Namespace directly and bypasses main(), so comment_id's type=int/nargs='?'/default=None wiring and the --issue/--marker additions are unverified. Shipped code is correct (verified), so this is a test-thoroughness gap, not a defect; a future edit dropping nargs='?' would pass the suite.

The isascii() conjunct of the --issue validation guard (issue.isascii() and issue.isdigit()) is untested. Tests cover 'abc' and '' (both isdigit()-false) but no Unicode-digit string that is isdigit()-true and isascii()-false, so removing the isascii() half would pass the whole suite. Shipped guard is correct.

skills/pr-description/SKILL.md collapses the read to `body --issue ... 2>/dev/null || true`, so exit 3 (transport/auth read failure) yields empty WORKPAD_BODY, silently dropping (post-merge) AC items with no breadcrumb. Not a regression — the prior two-call form masked failures identically via || true — and downstream `if WORKPAD_BODY is set` semantics are preserved.
